---
title: "5.4.5. Delete the data"
other-links:
  - text: "Version française"
    href: ../fr/5-4-5-supprimer-les-donnees.qmd
    icon: translate
---

The “Delete” section can be used to permanently delete data from the project.

 For that:

1.  Check the specific datasets that you want to delete in the “Select” column of the Available data table.
2.  Click the “Delete permanently” button which should have turned grey.
3.  Click once again on “Delete” in the new window that opens to confirm the deletion.

 Please note that the "Delete" action is not reversible.
